question: A charged particle of mass $m$ and charge $q>0$ moves in uniform, parallel fields $\vec{E} = E_0 \hat{k}$ and $\vec{B} = B_0 \hat{k}$ ($E_0,B_0>0$). It is projected from the origin with initial velocity $\vec{v}(0) = v_0 \hat{i}$ (so $v_z(0)=0$). Due to $\vec E$, the speed along $z$ increases with time, so the trajectory is a spiral with turn-dependent pitch. Find the pitch during the $n$-th turn, i.e. the distance traveled along the $z$-axis between the $(n-1)$-th and $n$-th revolutions about the $z$-axis.
